caption: The drawing depicts a square composition made up of various irregularly shaped fabric patches sewn together, resembling a crazy quilt. The patches are rendered in a wide range of colors, including black, yellow, red, green, orange, blue, white, pink, purple, beige, and brown. Some patches feature patterns such as stripes, checks, and floral designs. Notable details include embroidered yellow flowers on a black background in the upper left, a large pink flower with green leaves on the lower right, a green leaf motif on black in the upper right, and a sketched profile of a woman in a hat surrounded by yellow flowers in the center. Multiple types of decorative stitches in different colors, such as white, blue, red, pink, and yellow, are used to join the edges of the patches, adding detail and texture. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Patchwork Quilt (Section)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
